speaker: (narration)
current_text: FUN FACT

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A hamster does not know it is the engine of a civilization.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Beefcakes know. They bring snacks. The hamsters accept this arrangement.
new_text: The Beefcakes bring snacks. Civilization rests on the hamsters not finding out what a salary is.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: A regime enforcer, flexing at nobody in particular. Has been since breakfast. It's in the contract.
new_text: You see a regime enforcer flexing at nobody. Since breakfast, apparently; even his audience is exhausted.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: A tub of confiscated protein powder that learned to walk. Rattles. Sorry about the confiscation.
new_text: You hear confiscated protein powder rattle inside a walking tub. Whey out of line.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: Pure mandatory pre-workout. Zero chill. Vibrates through walls.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Shh. Welcome to the Gainlands. The regime has ears. Big ones. I'm Old Man Mountain. We Beefcakes power the kingdom on mills and hamster wheels, and move folks by throw and by portal.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Ten years back, {villain}'s people put Chancellor Clench in charge. Grandmaster Flex's own star pupil. They locked Flex under the House of Gains and took every weight. Every... every plate.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: We haven't crumbled. Tired, mind. If you fall, I catch you. Rule one: never lift alone. Rule two: never skip leg day. Rule three... I forget. Two is plenty.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Back for more? Good. The only bad rep is the one nobody spotted.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Beat the regime and I'll buy the first round of shakes. Illegal ones. The good flavour.
new_text: Beat the regime and I'll buy the first round of shakes. The illegal flavour... ah, that's the one worth remembering.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: The old king used to come up for the Lifting Festival every summer, with his boy. Little fella tried my dumbbell and sat down hard on his royal behind.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Laughed about it, too. Four colours in his hands, plain as day. You've got a look about you... never mind. Old man talk. Where was I.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: YOU DID IT. Flex is out, Clench is down, and I got to watch. Best day since... since the last best day. I'll be spotting you for the rest of your HP, like it or not.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: The weights are back in the gym. There's Gary, lifting. With a spotter. Beautiful. Before you go... that boy I told you about, the old king's son, at the Festival.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: When you lifted that last regime brute, you made the same face he did. Exactly the same face.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Free, strong and spotted. Thank you, friend. I climbed Swolympus once, you know. These ten years were steeper.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: LET'S GO! NEW RECRUIT! Coach Brutus Benchley! Retired champion, current motivator, part-time merchant! Protein, powder, pasteboard! Supplements for your DECK!

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: Officially, every card here is Regime-Approved Merchandise! (They are not.) Unofficially, they're from the good old days!
new_text: REGIME-APPROVED MERCHANDISE! Not actually approved, but these old cards have a GREAT ATTITUDE!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: *whispering* And do not stand on the loose floorboard behind the counter. There's nothing under it. Iron. Nothing.
new_text: *whispering* Mind the loose floorboard behind the counter. Nothing under it... just iron, which officially isn't anything.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: BACK ON THE FLOOR! The cards are pumped, the clipboard is ready, and my whistle has been WAITING for you!
new_text: LET'S GO, RETURNING CUSTOMER! The cards are pumped and my whistle has been SAVING ITS BREATH!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: *whispering* Floorboard's fine. Nobody's mentioned the floorboard.
new_text: *whispering* Nobody's mentioned the floorboard. I'd like to keep our relationship on that footing.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: LET'S GO! The iron came out from under the floorboard and went STRAIGHT onto a rack! Benchley's is open to EVERYONE!

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: The regime merchandise is in the clearance bin. All morning! Nobody wants it! BEAUTIFUL!
new_text: REGIME MERCHANDISE IN THE CLEARANCE BIN! Nobody wants it - my proudest day of not making a sale!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: Cards on the shelves, iron on the racks, whistle in my mouth! Some things are SACRED!
new_text: CARDS ON SHELVES, IRON ON RACKS! I can finally shout about the floorboard, and I'VE FORGOTTEN HOW!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Aha, a student! Professor Pump, Beefcake scholar, lecturing from this very log. I have written seventeen books.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Fifteen are about biceps. The regime burned the other two, so I rewrote them from memory. Footnotes included.
new_text: Fifteen concern biceps; the regime burned the other two, so I rewrote them from memory. You cannot confiscate a well-trained brain-cep.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Four questions on the Beefcakes, their energy and their transport. Every answer is on a sign, a poster or a Beefcake's lips somewhere in the Gainlands.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Answer well for gold and glory. Answer poorly and receive a mild, scholarly sigh. Today, we train the brain-ceps.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Back to improve your score? Splendid. Same weight, more reps, slightly bigger brain-ceps. That is the Beefcake way.
new_text: Back for another set of questions? Splendid - knowledge gains are retained even when you stop flexing.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Zero. Impressive, in a stubborn way. Nothing for you.
new_text: Zero, with no reward this time. A clean baseline; research begins somewhere.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: The signs are patient. I am less so. Read a sign. Any sign.
new_text: Consult the signs before your next attempt. Your eyes may do the heavy reading.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: One. A muscle twitch of knowledge. Take this pat on the back. It's a small one.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Two. Half-credit, graded on a bicep curve. In the Gainlands half a rep still counts. Just not for much.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Three! One shy of a clean sweep. Take your reward and flex responsibly.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: FOUR! A perfect set! You may now call yourself a Certified Gainer, Class A. The reward is real. The certificate is imaginary.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Another lap! The Gainlands pay a small processing fee for repeat attendance.

speaker: Professor Pump
current_text: Not a pass. Walk the Gainlands, read the signs, come back. Knowledge is a muscle, and yours just skipped leg day.
new_text: Not a pass yet; read the signs around the Gainlands and return. We are training recall, not regret.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: *cue synthesizer* Welcome, welcome, WELCOME to PUMP IT UP PAST MIDNIGHT! I'm your host, Chet Thunderabs, and it is 3 A.M. somewhere, which is where I live!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: You've seen the late-night tapes! 'Feel the burn!' But WAIT, there's MORE! My assistant is a legwarmer. My producer is ALSO a legwarmer.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: The regime banned the show for 'unauthorized fun'. I kept the cameras rolling anyway. Rebel. Spandex rebel.
new_text: The regime banned my show for 'unauthorized fun'! These cameras are STILL ROLLING - you can't spell resistance without... well, SPANDEX HELPS!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Today's show: REP COUNTER! Eight reps, one beat. Hit the beat and I give you a shiny medallion of pure encouragement!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Rewards for performance, plus a one-time bonus on your very first set! Three easy payments of gold? NO! FREE! Operators are standing by! And one, and two...

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Eight reps. Watch the ring: press SPACE (or click) the moment it closes on the bar. Perfect, Good, OK or Miss.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: The beat speeds up. Fewer misses, more stars.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: And ONE!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: And TWO!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Feel the burn!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Squeeze it!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Don't stop now!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Almost there!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: One more!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: FINISH IT!

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: THAT'S the way! You look incredible. The camera loves you. The camera also loves legwarmers.
new_text: THAT'S THE WAY - THE CAMERA LOVES YOU! And the legwarmers, but they've been trying to get a solo shot ALL NIGHT!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Your first set on the show! Here's your Pump Medallion: a bonus, free, no obligation. Operators are still standing by.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Not quite a set, champ. That's fine. Take a breath.

speaker: Chet Thunderabs
current_text: Rehydrate. Try again. The beat isn't going anywhere. Neither are the legwarmers.
new_text: REHYDRATE AND TRY AGAIN! The beat and the legwarmers are standing by - only one of those has legs!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Gary
current_text: Mmmph! Oh good, a spotter! Hi. Gary. Lovely to meet you.

speaker: Gary
current_text: I'm under this barbell. Have been since lunch. Possibly since the regime took over. No rush.
new_text: I've been under this barbell since lunch... possibly since the regime took over. No rush, but I would like to become a standing appointment.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Gary
current_text: It's the last barbell they didn't confiscate. I loaded one more plate than my confidence.

speaker: Gary
current_text: It's fine. It's FINE. Could you give it a little push? Bit of a rush, actually.

speaker: Gary
current_text: Spotter! You're a hero. One day I'm going to lift this barbell all the way up. Not today. But with you watching.
new_text: Spotter, you're a hero! One day this barbell and I will rise to the occasion... with you watching, please.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You grab the bar and heave. Gary slides out, gasping.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: "You're a hero! Take this. I borrowed it from the gym.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: It's not mine. It's yours now. That's how borrowing works, I think."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Gary is under a different barbell. It is a lighter barbell. His confidence is also lighter.
new_text: You find Gary under a different, lighter barbell. He has lowered the bar in every sense except the useful one.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You jump into the Colossal Hamster Wheel and run. And run. The grid hums, the lights across the Gainlands brighten, and somewhere a portal ripper rolls up her sleeves.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The wheel is already spinning happily. Let it coast. You deserve a snack.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A banana-berry shake. Smooth, sweet, suspiciously good for you. +HP.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A legendary chocolate-peanut-butter shake! Your muscles remember a childhood summer. Big recovery!
new_text: You taste a legendary chocolate-peanut-butter shake. Even your muscles want the recipe - big recovery!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Chalky. Lumpy. Tastes like drywall.
new_text: Chalky, lumpy... you appear to be drinking an unfinished wall.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You drink it anyway. -1 HP.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The cup has a coin at the bottom. The shake was just a front. +gold.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: An empty cup. Somebody drank your protein. It was the stand. It is always the stand.
new_text: You receive an empty cup. The stand has mistaken protein for a serving suggestion.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The stand wants 10 gold. You are as broke as a hamster on its day off.
new_text: The stand wants 10 gold. You have enthusiasm, which it does not accept.
writer_note: Keeps price and failure; removes the poverty comparison.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You flex. The mirror flexes back. You both nod. +1 HP.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You hit a double biceps. The mirror gasps. You gasp. +1 HP.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You hit the most-muscular pose. The mirror applauds. +1 HP.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Your pump has peaked. The mirror needs a moment. Come back after your next visit.
new_text: Your pump has peaked; come back after your next visit. Even your reflection needs a cooldown.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You flex, the mirror flexes back, nothing to heal. Looking great regardless.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Which brings me to rule one. Gary's under a barbell again. Go and spot him; follow the groaning. Then check your form at a Flex Mirror. The regime can't confiscate a reflection. They tried.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Do both and I'll have Rhonda rip you a portal to Calf Cove. Nobody's been out there in months. The calves are... unreal.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Spot Gary at his barbell, then flex at a Flex Mirror: the one at the Station or the one up on Pec Perch. Spot first, flex second, brag third.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: You spotted Gary AND checked your form? Beautiful. Here, a Pre-Workout Jitters. On the house.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Calf Cove's open to you now. Tell Rhonda I said hello. She'll pretend she didn't miss me.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
current_text: Calf Cove is yours. Mind the edge. Always mind the edge. I didn't, once, back in... never mind.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: Regime brutes, golems and sprites keep 'inspecting' my deliveries! Inspecting them right into their MOUTHS! Beat three roaming enemies out in the Gainlands, any three, in card duels!
new_text: Regime brutes, golems and sprites keep eating my deliveries! Beat any three roaming enemies in the Gainlands in card duels - END THE BULKING ORDERS!
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: I'll pay you in cards! STRONG cards! *whispering* Heavy ones. The kind the regime hasn't found yet.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: Three roaming enemies out in the Gainlands, champ! The brutes flex! The golems rattle!

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: The sprites buzz! Pick your poison and GET OUT THERE!

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: THREE DOWN! Deliveries back on schedule! Here's a Leg Day for your trouble. Do NOT skip it. That's not a joke. That's the card.

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
current_text: The lanes are clear! For about an hour! Then the regime fills them up again! BUT WHAT AN HOUR!

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Every machine hums at exactly the right wattage. The lift hums. The gate hums.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: The mill hums. Somewhere, a hamster sighs in relief. A small, heavy parcel drops into the tray.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: The grid purrs. Nothing left to route.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Start from the machine with the fewest options. The Mill needs 9, and only the wheels piped to it can supply it. Work out which wheel MUST feed the Gate.

current_text: The Lift

current_text: The Gate

speaker: (narration)
current_text: BY ORDER OF CHANCELLOR CLENCH

speaker: (narration)
current_text: 1. Weights are confiscated for your safety.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: 2. Protein is a privilege, not a right.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: 3. Mandatory Cardio Compliance, 5 AM sharp. Lateness is punished with more cardio.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: THE NEW HOUSE RULES

speaker: (narration)
current_text: 1. Weights are back. Lift responsibly.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: 2. Protein is a right. Also, a shake.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: 3. Cardio is optional. Leg day is not.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: CHANCELLOR CLENCH SAYS: "A BEEFCAKE WITHOUT IRON IS JUST A CAKE."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: (Printed on iron-free paper, naturally.)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: GRANDMASTER FLEX SAYS: "STRENGTH IS IN THE HEART AND THE MIND."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: (He would also like you to drink some water.)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: MISSING: OUR LEADER

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Grandmaster Flex. Ten years gone, dragged off to the House of Gains.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: If found, do not lift him. He is probably tired.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: - the Spotters

speaker: (narration)
current_text: FOUND: OUR LEADER

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Grandmaster Flex is back, and he is doing yoga on the roof of the House of Gains.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Do not spot him. He does not need it.
new_text: No spotter needed on the roof. He is holding that pose for himself.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Pump It Up

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: The whole zone is on a permanent pump. Beefcakes feel it in their quads.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Processing Time

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: "Your request is being processed." Necrocrats are used to forms and queues. Beefcakes just show up there-ish, on-time-ish, and the paperwork never catches up.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: Welcome, friend. Grandmaster Flex. Ten years in the dark, and the first thing I wanted was a window. The second was a stretch.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: They took my plates, my protein, my pre-workout. So I breathed. Breathe in. Hold. ...That is what I did for ten years.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: I counted my own heartbeats until they became songs. They thought they were breaking me. They were teaching me.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: Clench is learning to lift from zero. The strongest take the longest. The gym is open to everyone now. Come whenever you like.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: Lift what you can. Carry what you must. Put down what was never yours.

speaker: Grandmaster Flex, the Unbroken
current_text: And you, son. Whatever they took from you, it was not the part that matters. Now. Leg day?
new_text: And you, son: whatever they took from you, it was not the part that matters.
writer_note: Keeps C1 verbatim in substance; removes the leg-day wink from the captivity parallel.

speaker: Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent
current_text: STATUE OF CHANCELLOR CLENCH

speaker: Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent
current_text: "A Beefcake without iron is just a cake."

speaker: Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent
current_text: FORMER STATUE OF CHANCELLOR CLENCH

speaker: Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent
current_text: (Toppled by public demand. Please do not stand on it. Gary did, once.)

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The House of Gains

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The regime's stronghold. Far below it, in the Iron-less Prison, the true leader has been held for ten years. HP carries in from the zone; only the shrines heal. Beat Chancellor Clench to free the Gainlands.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The House of Gains is quiet, and the doors are open. You can still run the halls for gold and XP. HP carries in from the zone; nothing heals except at the shrines.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: Enter the House of Gains

speaker: (narration)
current_text: THE HOUSE OF GAINS

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Gates of Gains

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Iron-less steel, floodlights, and a banner reading MANDATORY CARDIO. Nobody has ever left through here.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The gates swing open on a hall lined with posters of Chancellor Clench. There are no weights anywhere. Not a dumbbell.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Not a kettlebell. Not a single decorative plate.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Somewhere beneath your feet, something is not quite silent. It is breathing. Slowly. On purpose.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Regime Checkpoint

speaker: (narration)
current_text: An enforcer searches your bag for weights while a clerk clicks a stopwatch. Minister Quota wants every search done in thirty seconds. He is at forty.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Descent

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A long stone stairway leads down into the Iron-less Prison.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Cell Block

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The prisoners are very quiet. The guards are very loud. Only one of these is a problem.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Calisthenics Check

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The prison has no iron, so it tests bodies. A guard demands to see your form.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Iron-less Warden

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The warden has never once lifted a weight. He has never needed to. He is very, very angry. (Elite)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The warden drops his keyring. At the end of the corridor, behind a door with no handle, someone is doing a very slow, very controlled push-up.
